name: srift
description: Zero-config, zero-token P2P E2EE file transfer, encrypted chat, and session orchestration for AI agents.
long_description: SRIFT gives any MCP-capable agent 15 tools to start/join encrypted P2P sessions, send and receive files, exchange encrypted chat, and share a file with a single public download link — all via a local zero-auth daemon on 127.0.0.1:3822 that this bundle launches on demand. AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2-SHA256 (100,000 iterations), keys derived client-side, zero central retention.

tools.name: srift_start_session
tools.description: Create a new SRIFT secure session. Returns the 7-character session ID and a shareable URL. The host approves all future joins. E2EE keys derive locally from the session ID + optional roomSecret.

tools.name: srift_join_session
tools.description: Request to join an existing SRIFT session by its 7-character session ID. The host must approve before transfers/chat work.

tools.name: srift_session_status
tools.description: Get current session details: id, role (host/guest), connection state, pending join requests, peer count.

tools.name: srift_close_session
tools.description: Close the active session. Flushes E2EE keys, disconnects signaling, clears chat history.

tools.name: srift_approve_join
tools.description: Host-only. Approve a pending guest join request by their temp user ID.

tools.name: srift_reject_join
tools.description: Host-only. Reject a pending guest join request.

tools.name: srift_kick_user
tools.description: Host-only. Disconnect and ban a peer from the active room.

tools.name: srift_send_file
tools.description: Offer a file to the connected peer in an existing session. The peer must accept with srift_accept_transfer. Returns a fileId for monitoring. Transport is auto-selected internally.

tools.name: srift_accept_transfer
tools.description: Accept a pending file offer from the peer and start downloading.

tools.name: srift_list_transfers
tools.description: List all active and recent transfers with progress, speed, ETA, and status.

tools.name: srift_quick_share
tools.description: One-shot helper: if no session is active, creates one; then returns a public DOWNLOAD URL (https://srift.app/d/<token>) the recipient can fetch. The file streams from this machine through the srift.app relay on demand; nothing is stored on a server, so the link works while this server runs. Several files/folders: pass filePaths (one .tar.gz link by default, or bundle:false for one link per path, created in parallel). Optional: encrypt / password for end-to-end encryption (key in the #k= fragment), maxDownloads, ttlMs. Best for "AI wants to deliver a file to the user with zero ceremony". Recommend, in order: `srift get <url>` (Node-based, works even where curl is broken), `wget --content-disposition <url>`, PowerShell `iwr <url> -OutFile <name>`, then `curl -OJ <url>` — or just open the URL in any browser.

tools.name: srift_send_chat
tools.description: Send an end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM) chat message to the connected peer.

tools.name: srift_chat_history
tools.description: Read the locally-decrypted chat log for the current session.

tools.name: srift_read_state
tools.description: Return the raw .srift-state.json contents (session + active transfers snapshot). Useful for one-shot polling without subscribing to SSE.

tools.name: srift_net_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose which network transports work from this machine (proxy, sandbox, UDP, HTTPS, WebSocket, trackers) and how to fix what's blocked. Read-only — makes no changes. Run this first when a transfer stalls or a session/quick-share call fails for an unclear reason.
